name: Strawberry Overnight Oats
preparationNote: Mix the oats, milk, and yogurt, then cover and chill overnight. Add the strawberries before eating.

name: Tropical Green Protein Smoothie
preparationNote: Blend the mango, banana, spinach, yogurt, and milk until smooth.

name: Spinach + Egg Breakfast Burrito
preparationNote: Scramble the eggs with spinach until set, then tuck into a warm tortilla with tomatoes and cheese.

name: Apple Cinnamon Oats + Eggs
preparationNote: Cook the oats in milk with chopped apple and cinnamon. Cook the eggs until set and serve alongside.

name: Chicken Crunch Wrap
preparationNote: Cut the chicken into small pieces and cook in a nonstick pan until cooked through. Spread yogurt on a tortilla, add the chicken, lettuce, and tomatoes, then fold into a wrap.

name: Chickpea + Egg Salad
preparationNote: Boil the eggs until firm, then cool, peel, and chop. Toss with drained canned chickpeas, spinach, cucumber, and tomatoes.

name: Tuna Salad Sandwich with Tomato Cucumber + Feta Salad
preparationNote: Drain the tuna and put it between slices of bread, mixing in yogurt if you like. Serve with chopped tomatoes, cucumber, and feta on the side.

name: Chicken + Quinoa Veggie Bowl
preparationNote: Cook the quinoa while you cook small pieces of chicken in a nonstick pan until cooked through. Steam the broccoli and peppers until tender, then serve together in a bowl.

name: Turkey Chili Rice Bowl
preparationNote: Start the rice, then brown the turkey and onions in a nonstick pan. Add canned tomatoes and drained canned kidney beans, with chili powder if you like, then simmer until the turkey is cooked through and serve over rice.

name: Beef + Broccoli with Noodles
preparationNote: Boil the noodles while you cook thin beef strips in a nonstick pan. Add broccoli and soy sauce, cover until the broccoli is tender and beef is cooked through, then toss with the noodles.

name: Chicken + Black Bean Quesadilla
preparationNote: Cook small pieces of chicken in a nonstick pan until cooked through, then warm with drained canned black beans. Fill a tortilla with the chicken, beans, and cheese, fold, and toast until the cheese melts.

name: Spinach + Cheese Tortilla Pizza
preparationNote: Spread tomato sauce on a tortilla and top with spinach and mozzarella. Bake until the cheese melts and the edges are crisp.

name: Turkey Burger + Sweet Potato Wedges
preparationNote: Cut the sweet potato into wedges and roast on a lined tray until tender. Shape the turkey into patties, cook through in a nonstick pan, and serve in buns with lettuce and tomatoes.

name: Sweet Thai Chili Salmon with Rice + Green Beans
preparationNote: Start the rice, then brush salmon with sweet Thai chili sauce and bake until cooked through. Steam the green beans and serve alongside the salmon and rice.

name: Chicken Veggie Stir-Fry
preparationNote: Start the rice, then cook thin chicken strips in a nonstick pan until cooked through. Add broccoli, peppers, and soy sauce, cook until the vegetables are tender, and serve over rice.

name: Garlic Chicken with Roasted Sweet Potatoes + Cauliflower
preparationNote: Roast chopped sweet potatoes and cauliflower on a lined tray with garlic, adding olive oil if you like. Bake the chicken alongside until cooked through and serve when the vegetables are tender.

name: Walnut Cashew + Pumpkin Seed Trail Mix
Smoked Salmon + Avocado Toast
preparationNote: Toast the bread, spread with mashed avocado, and top with smoked salmon.

name: Sweet Potato + Egg Breakfast Hash
preparationNote: Dice the sweet potato small and microwave until just tender. Cook with chopped peppers and onions in a nonstick pan, then add eggs and cook until set.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Overnight Oats
preparationNote: Stir the oats, milk, and peanut butter together, then cover and chill overnight. Top with sliced banana before eating.

name: Spinach Mushroom + Feta Omelet
preparationNote: Cook the mushrooms and spinach in a nonstick pan, then pour in beaten eggs. Add feta and fold once the eggs are set.

name: Breakfast Egg + Black Bean Tacos
preparationNote: Scramble the eggs until set and warm the drained canned black beans. Fill warm corn tortillas with the eggs, beans, and chopped tomatoes.

name: Chia Pudding with Mango + Pumpkin Seeds
preparationNote: Stir chia seeds into milk, stir again once they start to thicken, then cover and chill until set. Top with mango and pumpkin seeds.

name: Avocado + Egg Breakfast Sandwich
preparationNote: Cook the egg until set, then place on toasted bread with mashed avocado.

name: Tofu Scramble with Peppers + Potatoes
preparationNote: Dice the potatoes small and microwave until just tender. Cook them with chopped peppers and crumbled tofu in a nonstick pan until the peppers soften and the tofu is hot.

name: Peanut Butter + Strawberry Toast with Yogurt
preparationNote: Spread peanut butter on toast and top with sliced strawberries. Serve the yogurt on the side.

name: Salmon + Spinach Breakfast Wrap
preparationNote: Drain the canned salmon, then tuck into a tortilla with spinach and roll up. Add a cooked egg if you like.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes with Greek Yogurt
preparationNote: Blend banana, eggs, and rolled oats into a batter. Cook small pancakes in a nonstick pan until set on both sides and serve with Greek yogurt.

name: Lentil + Roasted Vegetable Grain Bowl
preparationNote: Roast chopped zucchini and peppers on a lined tray while the quinoa cooks. Warm drained canned lentils and combine everything in a bowl, adding olive oil if you like.

name: Salmon + Avocado Rice Bowl
preparationNote: Start the rice, then bake the salmon until cooked through. Serve with the rice, sliced avocado, and cucumber.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Pita
preparationNote: Drain canned chickpeas and lightly mash them. Fill a pita with the chickpeas, chopped cucumber, and tomatoes, adding feta if you like.

name: Turkey + Hummus Veggie Wrap
preparationNote: Spread hummus on a tortilla, layer with ready-to-eat sliced turkey and spinach, then roll up.

name: Black Bean + Corn Burrito Bowl
preparationNote: Cook the rice and steam the corn until tender, then warm drained canned black beans. Serve in a bowl with chopped tomatoes and warm tortillas on the side.

name: Sardine + Tomato Toast
preparationNote: Toast the bread and top with drained canned sardines and sliced tomatoes. Add lemon if you like.

name: Chicken + White Bean Soup
preparationNote: Simmer chopped carrots and onions in broth, then add small pieces of chicken and cook through. Stir in drained canned white beans and heat until hot, adding spinach if you like.

name: Tofu + Edamame Noodle Bowl
preparationNote: Boil the noodles and cook the edamame as directed on the package, removing any pods. Steam diced tofu and sliced carrots until hot and tender, then combine with the noodles and edamame beans, adding soy sauce if you like.

name: Greek Chicken + Cucumber Pita
preparationNote: Cut the chicken into small pieces, season with dried oregano if you like, and cook in a nonstick pan until cooked through. Fill a pita with the chicken, chopped cucumber, and yogurt, adding lemon if you like.

name: Sweet Potato + Black Bean Bowl
preparationNote: Start the rice and roast chopped sweet potato on a lined tray until tender. Warm drained canned black beans with spinach until the leaves soften, then serve over rice with the sweet potato.

name: Shrimp + Mango Rice Bowl
preparationNote: Start the rice, then cook shrimp and chopped peppers in a nonstick pan until the shrimp are cooked through. Serve over rice with chopped mango, adding lime if you like.

name: Egg + Avocado Salad Sandwich
preparationNote: Boil the eggs until firm, then cool, peel, and chop. Mash with avocado and put between slices of bread with lettuce.

name: Lentil + Spinach Soup with Whole-Grain Toast
preparationNote: Simmer lentils and chopped carrots in broth until the lentils are tender. Stir in spinach until wilted and serve with toast.

name: Tuna + White Bean Salad
preparationNote: Drain the canned tuna and canned white beans, then toss with chopped tomatoes and spinach. Add olive oil if you like.

name: Chicken Pesto Pasta Salad
preparationNote: Boil the pasta while you cook small pieces of chicken in a nonstick pan until cooked through. Toss with pesto and halved cherry tomatoes, adding spinach if you like. Serve warm, or chill if you prefer.

name: Roasted Vegetable + Feta Couscous Bowl
preparationNote: Roast chopped zucchini and peppers on a lined tray until tender, adding olive oil if you like. Prepare the couscous as directed on the package, then toss with the vegetables and feta.

name: Lemon Garlic Salmon + Quinoa + Asparagus
preparationNote: Cook the quinoa while you bake the salmon with garlic and lemon until cooked through. Steam the asparagus and serve everything together, adding olive oil if you like.

name: Beef + Black Bean Stuffed Peppers
preparationNote: Cook the rice while you brown the beef in a nonstick pan until cooked through, then mix with drained canned black beans. Fill halved peppers, add cheese if you like, and bake until the peppers are tender.

name: Turkey + Spinach Meatballs with Pasta
preparationNote: Mix ground turkey with finely chopped spinach and egg, adding breadcrumbs if you like, then shape into small meatballs. Bake until cooked through while the pasta boils, then serve with warmed tomato sauce.

name: Coconut Chickpea + Spinach Curry with Rice
preparationNote: Start the rice, then simmer drained canned chickpeas in coconut milk with curry powder. Stir in spinach until wilted and serve over rice.

name: Sheet-Pan Chicken + Brussels Sprouts + Potatoes
preparationNote: Put chicken thighs, chopped potatoes, and halved Brussels sprouts on a lined tray, adding olive oil if you like. Roast until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.

name: Garlic Shrimp + Vegetable Pasta
preparationNote: Boil the pasta while you cook shrimp, zucchini, and garlic in a nonstick pan until the shrimp are cooked through. Toss with the pasta, adding olive oil or spinach if you like.

name: Baked Tofu + Peanut Noodles
preparationNote: Bake tofu cubes on a lined tray until firm while the noodles boil. Stir peanut butter and soy sauce with some noodle cooking water, then toss with the tofu, noodles, and shredded carrots.

name: Lentil Bolognese with Whole-Wheat Pasta
preparationNote: Cook the lentils until tender, then simmer with tomato sauce and chopped onions until the onions soften. Boil the pasta while the sauce simmers, then serve together.

name: Fish Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
preparationNote: Bake the fish until cooked through while you mix shredded cabbage with yogurt, adding lime if you like. Fill warm tortillas with the fish and slaw.

name: Beef + Vegetable Stir-Fry with Rice
preparationNote: Start the rice, then cook thin beef strips in a nonstick pan. Add broccoli, peppers, and soy sauce, cook until the vegetables are tender and beef is cooked through, and serve over rice.

name: Black-Eyed Pea + Sweet Potato Stew
preparationNote: Simmer chopped sweet potato and onions in canned tomatoes until tender, adding a splash of water if needed. Stir in drained canned black eyed peas and heat through, adding spinach if you like.

name: Turkey + Kidney Bean Chili
preparationNote: Brown the turkey and chopped onions in a nonstick pan. Add canned tomatoes and drained canned kidney beans, with chili powder if you like, then simmer until the turkey is cooked through and the sauce thickens.

name: Baked Trout + Roasted Carrots + Rice
preparationNote: Start the rice and roast sliced carrots on a lined tray. Bake the trout until cooked through and serve with the rice and tender carrots, adding lemon if you like.

name: Chicken Fajita Bowls
preparationNote: Start the rice, then cook thin chicken strips in a nonstick pan until cooked through. Add sliced peppers and onions, cook until tender, and serve over rice with avocado if you like.

name: Spinach + Ricotta Stuffed Shells
preparationNote: Boil the shells until just tender while you cook and drain the spinach, then mix the spinach with ricotta. Fill the shells, place in tomato sauce, and bake until hot, adding mozzarella if you like.

name: Ginger Salmon + Broccoli Noodle Bowl
preparationNote: Boil the noodles and steam the broccoli while you bake the salmon with ginger and soy sauce until cooked through. Serve together, adding sesame seeds if you like.

name: Boiled Eggs + Orange Slices
preparationNote: Boil the eggs until firm, then cool and peel. Serve with orange slices.

name: Roasted Chickpeas + Bell Pepper Strips
preparationNote: Drain, rinse, and dry canned chickpeas well, then spread on a lined tray, adding olive oil if you like. Roast until crisp, stirring partway through, and serve with raw bell pepper strips.

name: Edamame + Mandarin Orange
preparationNote: Cook the edamame as directed on the package, then serve with mandarin orange pieces. If the edamame comes in pods, eat the beans and leave the pods.

name: Strawberry Banana Protein Smoothie
preparationNote: Blend the yogurt, strawberries, banana, milk, and chia seeds until smooth. Add protein powder if you like.

name: Blueberry Almond Butter Smoothie
preparationNote: Blend the blueberries, almond butter, yogurt, milk, and ground flaxseed until smooth.

name: Mango Pineapple Protein Smoothie
preparationNote: Blend the mango, pineapple, yogurt, milk, and chia seeds until smooth. Add protein powder if you like.

name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
preparationNote: Blend the banana, peanut butter, cocoa powder, milk, and yogurt until smooth. Add protein powder if you like.

name: Kiwi Avocado Green Smoothie
preparationNote: Blend the kiwi, avocado, spinach, yogurt, and milk until smooth.

name: BBQ Chicken Rice Bowl
preparationNote: Start the rice and steam the corn while you cook small pieces of chicken in a nonstick pan until cooked through. Stir BBQ sauce into the chicken and serve over rice with the corn, sliced cabbage, and peppers.

name: BBQ Chicken with Roasted Sweet Potatoes + Broccoli
preparationNote: Roast chopped sweet potato on a lined tray and bake the chicken thighs with BBQ sauce until cooked through. Add broccoli to roast until tender and serve together.

name: Ground Turkey Taco Bowl
preparationNote: Start the rice, then brown the turkey in a nonstick pan until cooked through, adding taco seasoning if you like, and warm drained canned black beans. Serve with the rice, lettuce, tomatoes, and avocado.

name: Ground Turkey + Spinach Skillet with Rice
preparationNote: Start the rice, then brown the turkey and chopped onions in a nonstick pan until the turkey is cooked through. Stir in chopped tomatoes and spinach, cook until softened, and serve over rice.

name: Pesto Chicken Pasta
preparationNote: Boil the pasta while you cook small pieces of chicken in a nonstick pan until cooked through. Toss with pesto, halved cherry tomatoes, and spinach until the leaves soften.

name: Pesto Chicken + Quinoa Bowl
preparationNote: Cook the quinoa while you cook small pieces of chicken in a nonstick pan until cooked through. Add chopped zucchini and tomatoes, cook until tender, then stir in pesto and serve over quinoa.

name: Mac + Cheese with Chicken + Broccoli
preparationNote: Boil the macaroni and steam the broccoli while you cook small pieces of chicken in a nonstick pan until cooked through. Gently warm milk with grated cheddar until melted, then stir in the pasta, chicken, and broccoli.

name: Jerk Chicken Pasta
preparationNote: Boil the pasta while you cook small chicken pieces with jerk seasoning in a nonstick pan until cooked through, then add sliced peppers and onions and cook until soft. Lower the heat, stir in milk and Parmesan, and toss with the pasta.

name: Sweet Thai Chili Tofu Bowl
preparationNote: Start the rice, then cook tofu cubes in a nonstick pan until hot. Add broccoli, peppers, and sweet Thai chili sauce, cover until the vegetables are tender, and serve over rice.

name: Mac + Cheese with Black Beans + Roasted Cauliflower
preparationNote: Roast cauliflower on a lined tray while the macaroni boils, then warm drained canned black beans. Gently warm milk with grated cheddar until melted, then combine with the pasta, beans, and cauliflower.

name: Honey Garlic Salmon Bites Bowl
preparationNote: Start the rice, then mix honey, garlic, and soy sauce. Cook salmon cubes in a nonstick pan until cooked through, toss with the sauce until hot, and serve over rice with cucumber and avocado.

name: Salmon Cakes with Roasted Potatoes + Side Salad
preparationNote: Roast chopped potatoes on a lined tray while you mix drained canned salmon with egg and breadcrumbs and shape into small patties. Bake the patties until cooked through and serve with the tender potatoes and mixed greens, adding lemon over the greens.

name: Chocolate Raspberry Chia Pudding
preparationNote: Mix chia seeds, milk, cocoa powder, and yogurt, then cover and chill until thick, stirring again as it starts to set. Top with raspberries before eating.

name: Protein Waffles with Berries + Greek Yogurt
preparationNote: Prepare the waffle mix as directed on the package and cook in a waffle maker. Top with yogurt, strawberries, and blueberries, adding almond butter if you like.

name: Caribbean Stew Chicken Legs with Rice + Cabbage
preparationNote: Brown the chicken legs in a nonstick pot, then add chopped onions, tomatoes, and carrots, using green seasoning if you like. Cover and simmer, adding a splash of water if needed, until the chicken is cooked through, and serve with freshly cooked rice and steamed cabbage.

name: Roasted Vegetable + Chickpea Tray Bake
preparationNote: Drain canned chickpeas and toss with chopped zucchini, peppers, cauliflower, and olive oil, then roast until the vegetables are tender. Drizzle with tahini and add tzatziki if you like.

name: White Bean + Spinach Tomato Skillet
preparationNote: Cook chopped tomatoes and garlic in olive oil until softened, then add drained canned white beans and spinach and heat through. Serve with toast, adding feta if you like.

name: Apple Nachos with Peanut Butter + Pumpkin Seeds
preparationNote: Slice the apple, spread the slices on a plate, then drizzle with peanut butter and scatter pumpkin seeds over the top. Add chocolate chips if you like.

name: Mini Caprese Skewers
preparationNote: Thread cherry tomatoes, bite-size mozzarella pieces, and basil onto small skewers. Add balsamic glaze if you like.

name: Turkey + Cheese Roll-Ups with Grapes
preparationNote: Roll ready-to-eat turkey slices around pieces of cheddar and serve with grapes and crackers.
